items.title: 编写 Parallel Development 能力执行文档
items.context: 创建 Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md，要求详细但克制：它是加速开发的横向能力，不新增能力声明层；必须包含与 Loop Engineering/UDM 的关系、并行开发约束、顺序证明和停止条件。
items.userSees: 用户打开 Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md 会看到标题 "Lattice Parallel Development Capability Execution Plan"，并看到核心规则 "Implementation may proceed in parallel; capability proof and claim unlock must remain sequential." 文档还包含 Relationship To Loop Engineering、Shared Contract Freeze、Workstream Ownership、Shadow Mode、Merge Queue、Dogfooding Plan。

happy.desc: 文档包含 Lattice Parallel Development 的定义、核心规则 parallel implementation / sequential proof、共享契约冻结、workstream 分区、ownership、merge queue 和 dogfooding plan。

edge.desc: 文档必须明确 Parallel Development 不是第 6 层 baseline，不产生新的能力声明，不替代 Parallel Wave、Loop Engineering、Capability Claim 或 Authority gates。

adversarial.desc: 文档必须防止并行开发导致 false DONE、schema drift、host 自证、共享文件互相覆盖、高层 claim 提前 PASS；相关情况必须 fail closed 或 human handoff。

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --check -- Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md && rg -n "Lattice Parallel Development|parallel implementation, sequential proof|Shared Contract Freeze|Workstream Partition|Ownership And Lease Rules|Merge Queue|Dogfooding Plan" Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document defines Lattice Parallel Development and includes the core rule, shared contract freeze, workstream partition, ownership, merge queue, and dogfooding plan.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "not a sixth baseline|Non-Goals|Replace Loop Engineering|Replace REVIEW, TEST, DONE|Parallel Wave|Capability Claim|Authority gates" Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document explicitly says Parallel Development is not a sixth baseline and does not replace Parallel Wave, Loop Engineering, Capability Claim, lifecycle gates, or Authority gates.
Document includes fail-closed handling for false DONE, schema drift, host self-certification, stale evidence, ownership conflicts, lower-layer proof gaps, and human-only decisions.
